nodes.label: Spring class
nodes.why: react-spring's damped solver at 1ms substeps, mass 1; also supports duration/easing tweens; snaps immediately under prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.label: revealBlock()
nodes.why: Each block's reveals are timed from the block's arrival at PACE 0.6, brisker than the delays written in the markup.

nodes.label: Hero scene init (WebGL2 probe, patience timeout, render loop)
nodes.why: Without WebGL2 the still portrait is shown; slow networks lift the veil with the still portrait after 15s and hand over later; the render loop runs only while the hero is uncovered and the tab is visible; height-only resizes on coarse pointers (iOS URL bar) are ignored.

nodes.label: ACCA island map block (SVG map and trace canvas)
nodes.why: Islands are flat shapes so the route is the loudest thing on the map; one lap runs when the block arrives and brakes into the next exam, then cools and the next exam pulses; labels stay 12.5 real pixels at any stage scale; on phones only exams sat and to sit are named.

nodes.label: British Management University (BSc Accounting and Finance)
PASSED / EXEMPT / NEXT_EXAM exam status
nodes.why: Where each exam stands, read by the ACCA map. The hero's progress panel, the journey's Next card and the results strip repeat it by hand, so all four change together.

nodes.label: Education strip block (recognition and exams)
nodes.why: Cards in order with connectors crawling toward the live entry, a pulsing live marker and a bracket that spreads on hover; the figure drifts up only over the block's crossing.

nodes.label: Journey timeline block (rail, parallax rows, route cards)
nodes.why: Three parallax layers per row each pass their design position mid-screen; the rail marker turns five times over the run and rests on the last entry; years assemble letter by letter and a centre row's year settles back to 60% opacity.

nodes.label: contours() 2D contour canvas
nodes.why: The hero's wave field redrawn on a 2D canvas by marching squares for the education, skills and contact blocks, at most once every 24ms, static under reduced motion.

nodes.label: loopInView()
nodes.why: Runs a frame callback only while the element is in view (IntersectionObserver) plus ten grace frames, so off-screen animation costs nothing.

nodes.label: routeCard()
nodes.why: A job drawn as a line with one point per month there; pointing at or tapping a point names its month; an ongoing job (data-to=now) grows by itself; a seeded random draws the same line at every width.

nodes.label: Static @font-face declarations (Fontsource via jsDelivr)
nodes.why: Static font files instead of Google's variable ones, because Chrome's PDF export splits words in variable fonts and screening software reads the PDF text.

nodes.label: Cyan accent (#02d2e3, --accent)
nodes.why: The one accent: rules, mastheads on dark, fills, glows; kept for shapes on the light ground.

nodes.label: revealFor()
nodes.why: Maps data-reveal/data-enter kinds (words, letters, fade, rule, rise-sm, rise) to revealers; a paragraph arrives within WORDS_SPAN (600ms) however many words it has.

nodes.label: CIRCUIT_PATH resampled track
nodes.why: Waypoints over each island joined by centripetal Catmull-Rom (no loops on uneven spacing), resampled at a fixed step using chord lengths because the SVG measures the polyline it is given.

nodes.label: ISLANDS (ACCA levels as islands)
nodes.why: The qualification as four isometric islands walked in ACCA's own order: Applied Knowledge, Applied Skills, Strategic Professional, Options.

nodes.label: readToken()
nodes.why: Resolves a CSS design token to a concrete colour through a hidden probe's computed colour, so canvas/WebGL code uses the same palette as the CSS.

nodes.label: A4 CV sheet (.sheet)
nodes.why: Ligatures, alternates and kerning are off because the PDF export cannot map them back to text (and kerning with ligatures off splits words).

nodes.label: Instrument panel layout
nodes.why: A light art-directed sheet with black type, near-black blocks and one cyan accent, laid out like an instrument panel: bracket corners, chamfered buttons, dashed grids, figures in a condensed face.

nodes.label: CV update and PDF export procedure
Sticky stack (pinned layers recede)
nodes.why: Hero, ACCA and journey blocks are sticky layers; the covered layer scales to 0.9 and shades to 0.55 instead of scrolling away. No transform at rest because it would become the containing block for fixed children; no shrink on phones.

nodes.label: subscribe()
nodes.why: Starts the shared rAF loop on first subscriber and cancels it when the last unsubscribes, so nothing ticks when idle.

nodes.label: Spring-only motion
nodes.why: Everything that moves is a spring (tension and friction, mass 1); no CSS keyframes, and CSS transitions only for hover colours, button floods, side plate inset and route card points.

nodes.label: Print stylesheet (@page A4)
nodes.why: Letter-spacing is forced to 0 in print because tracking splits words in the PDF text too.

nodes.label: 12px type floor (--type-floor)
nodes.why: Nothing on screen is set below 12px; the ACCA map sizes labels against its own scale and plate words are real-pixel HTML, never text inside a scaled image.

nodes.label: targetTop()
nodes.why: A pinned layer's place is where its flow position would be, computed by summing preceding layer heights.

nodes.label: Green Group LLC (Business Analyst, Fuel Department Manager)
splitText()
nodes.why: Keeps the plain text in an sr-only span and hides the split units from assistive tech, so animated text stays accessible.

nodes.label: getSceneTier() device tier
nodes.why: Classifies mobile/tablet/desktop to set max DPR, a 60fps frame cap off desktop, antialiasing, trail sample count, scan and reveal, and freezes the scene under reduced motion or mobile save-data.

nodes.label: HeroScene.load()
nodes.why: Loads diffuse, depth, alpha and normal maps, pre-uploads textures and compiles shaders asynchronously before the first render so the veil lifts onto a ready scene.

nodes.label: Loading veil (silhouette loader)
nodes.why: A silhouette fills from the top with a meter along the foot; progress creeps to 0.7 and completes the moment the scene is ready; the page cannot scroll under it.

nodes.label: window.__rescue plain-HTML fallback
nodes.why: If the module script never starts (no import maps, failed load, crash before the veil lifts, or 12s timeout), lift the veil and show everything as plain HTML.

nodes.label: Off the map layout (.lost)
nodes.why: GitHub Pages serves this page for any missing address from any folder, so every link and asset path starts at /.

nodes.label: Vendored three.js 0.185
nodes.why: Kept in vendor/ and served from khadi.uz rather than a CDN, so a network that blocks CDNs can't break the page.

nodes.label: Local server (python3 -m http.server)
nodes.why: Browsers block the hero's textures and module imports on file:// pages.

nodes.label: No build step (plain HTML, CSS, JS)
nodes.why: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no build step, so nothing needs installing.

nodes.label: buildRevealDeclarations()
nodes.why: Shared GLSL uniforms and the cursor-trail plus idle-sweep-trail reveal functions, injected into both the blueprint and backdrop shaders.

nodes.label: jumpTo()
nodes.why: Native smooth scrolling for in-page links; below the hero the target clears the dock height, and focus moves to the section.

nodes.label: Cyan ink (#007a85, --accent-ink)
nodes.why: Cyan on the light ground is too pale for text, so words there use the darker cyan ink.

nodes.label: Two-tier CSS variables (raw vs role tokens)
nodes.why: Tier 1 (--raw-...) is the only place a hex code appears; components read tier 2 roles (--background, --accent) and never raw values, so a colour changes in one place.

nodes.label: Dock (sticky top menu)
nodes.why: Slides in once the hero is half gone and marks the section whose top has passed 40% of the screen; nearly opaque rather than blurred because a full-width backdrop blur costs whole frames on slower machines.

nodes.label: forward()
nodes.why: Plays in when on screen, holds rather than reversing on the way back up, and only resets once entirely below the screen, so on-screen text is never hidden.

nodes.label: TIME_AT curvature pacing
nodes.why: Pacing lives in the path's curvature: the lap slows through the turns (CORNER_BRAKE 9).

nodes.label: fitSubjectToBox()
nodes.why: Keeps the portrait at the size and place a layout-owned box gives it while the canvas spans the whole block (below xl).

nodes.label: makeNoiseTexture()
nodes.why: A tileable, seeded value-noise DataTexture for the blueprint burn front and the reveal's wobble.

nodes.label: three.js (self-hosted via import map)
nodes.why: Served from vendor/three on this site, not a CDN: if a network blocks the CDN, the page still works.

nodes.label: Apple Vision cut-outs
nodes.why: Depth and normal maps were derived from the cut-outs, so they are approximations rather than scans.

nodes.label: Google Search Console verification
nodes.why: Keep the verification file and meta tag, or Search Console stops trusting the site.

nodes.label: Journey rows (route cards and note cards)
Seams (colour fade between light and dark blocks)
nodes.why: Where a light block meets a dark one, the colour of the block above lies over the top of the next and fades as it rises.

nodes.label: Design tokens from brand.css
nodes.why: Colour, type and motion tokens (--accent, --surface-black, --type-*, --duration-*) come from the shared brand.css; the page only adds layout.

nodes.label: Halftone blueprint reveal
nodes.why: A halftone ink-and-cyan blueprint of the portrait arrives whole, burns away crown to chin along a ragged noise front, and afterwards exists only where the cursor (or an idle sweep on touch) has just been.

nodes.label: Word and letter text reveals
nodes.why: Reveals start as soon as a block reaches the screen and reset only once it is entirely below, so text on screen is never hidden.

nodes.label: Menu sheet (below xl)
nodes.why: Appended to body, never inside the masthead; one burger in the masthead and one in the dock, focus returns to whichever opened it; closes when the viewport reaches xl.

nodes.label: Orange danger (#ff6b00, --danger)
nodes.why: Reserved for errors only, never decoration.

nodes.label: Plain, specific voice
nodes.why: Say what was done and what it changed, in short sentences, with no buzzwords.

nodes.label: Static Fontsource fonts for the CV
nodes.why: Chrome's PDF export splits words set in variable fonts and recruiters' screening software reads the PDF text, so the CV uses static font files.

nodes.label: tick() shared ticker
nodes.why: One requestAnimationFrame loop for the whole page; each subscriber runs only when its own framerate interval has elapsed.

nodes.label: reportFailure()
nodes.why: A failed load must be visible: a banner names every asset that did not arrive instead of failing silently.

nodes.label: Real-ESRGAN 4x upscaling
nodes.why: Photos arrived at 768x1024, too small for Retina; enlarged 4x before cut-out, with a plain resample over faces so the model can't change a feature.

nodes.label: Loading-screen fallback script
nodes.why: If the page script cannot run, a small fallback lifts the loading screen and shows plain HTML with the still portrait.

nodes.label: headFragment shader (depth parallax and relight)
nodes.why: Fake-depth parallax from a depth map, then a relight off the normal map toward the cursor; past the photo's foot it blurs the clamped last row so the shirt runs off the frame instead of streaking.

nodes.label: Native browser scrolling
nodes.why: Nothing takes over the wheel or trackpad; in-page links use the browser's own smooth scroll.

nodes.label: scaleRoot()
nodes.why: The root font-size keeps scaling above 1920px, continuing the CSS bands where one rem equals one design pixel of the 1440 frame.

sets.label: Keeping the CV PDF's text machine-readable
